name: bilibili-hot-monitor
description: 生成B站热门视频日报并发送邮件。触发词：B站热门、bilibili日报、视频日报、热门视频

en.tagline: Daily email digest of trending Bilibili videos
en.summary: This skill builds a daily report of trending Bilibili videos and emails it. For each video it can add an AI summary based on the subtitles and an AI comment. The report is sent as an HTML email with the current date in the subject.
problem: Checking Bilibili's trending list by hand takes time, and it is hard to tell which videos are worth watching from titles alone.
With this skill, the agent collects the trending videos, extracts their subtitles, and asks an OpenRouter model for a summary and a comment on each. The user gets one email with the full report.
fit: Getting a daily email of trending Bilibili videos
Reading short AI summaries of videos before deciding what to watch
Users who have a Gmail account with an app password and an OpenRouter API key
unfit: Users who do not want to provide a Bilibili cookie or a Gmail app password
Runs that must finish in a few minutes, since a full run takes 10-15 minutes
steps: The agent checks whether `bilibili-monitor.json` exists in the skill folder.
If the config is missing, the agent asks in turn for the Bilibili cookies, whether to enable AI, the model, the Gmail sender address and app password, and the recipient addresses.
The agent writes these values to `bilibili-monitor.json` on the local device.
After the user confirms, the agent runs `generate_report.py`, which fetches trending videos, extracts subtitles, and calls the AI model for summaries and comments.
The agent runs `send_email.py`, which sends the report file as an HTML email.

zh.tagline: B站热门视频日报，邮件发送
zh.summary: 这个 Skill 生成 B站热门视频日报，并以邮件发送。开启 AI 后，每个视频会基于字幕生成总结，并附上 AI 点评。邮件为 HTML 格式，标题自动使用当天日期。
problem: 手动查看 B站热门列表费时，仅凭标题很难判断哪些视频值得看。
使用本 Skill 后，Agent 会获取热门视频，提取字幕，并调用 OpenRouter 模型为每个视频生成总结和点评。用户收到的是一封包含完整报告的邮件。
fit: 希望每天通过邮件收到 B站热门视频
想先读 AI 总结再决定看哪个视频
已有 Gmail 账号、应用密码和 OpenRouter API Key 的用户
unfit: 不愿提供 B站 Cookies 或 Gmail 应用密码的用户
需要在几分钟内完成的任务，完整执行需要 10-15 分钟
steps: Agent 检查 Skill 目录下是否存在 `bilibili-monitor.json`。
如果配置文件不存在，Agent 依次询问 B站 Cookies、是否启用 AI、模型、Gmail 发件邮箱和应用密码，以及收件人邮箱。
Agent 将这些信息写入本地设备上的 `bilibili-monitor.json`。
用户确认后，Agent 运行 `generate_report.py`，获取热门视频、提取字幕，并调用 AI 模型生成总结和点评。
Agent 运行 `send_email.py`，将报告文件以 HTML 邮件形式发送。
